implementation_evidence: Pre-fix actual PostgreSQL regression confirmed duplicate credit. Post-fix independent claim/trade9, manifest17, privacyPG6 and privacyChrome9 passed with stable sources. These do not establish the combined Square receiving/provider assertions below.
scope: Development/oauth-receiving source, current official Square documentation and fresh ss_test PostgreSQL fixtures; no merchant records, secrets, provider transactions, production migration or deployment.
invariants: tenant scope derives only from a current authenticated staff session
physical intake identity is central and is not a client receipt UUID, request key, filename or price
duplicate source claims converge across PCs and receiving locations
additional physical delivery requires an explicit linked authorization, never a changed request key
accepted trade credit and receiving share the physical claim before acceptance
provider tenant/merchant/environment/app/location identity cannot change during retry
server computes typed provider payloads; no Square tokens or raw provider proxy reach desktop
every external mutation has a durable exact request/key/API version/timestamp before dispatch
uncertainty retains claim/lane and original retry identity
old prices, siblings, catalog fields and existing stock variants are preserved
only selected confirmed additive quantities are reported as received
no receiving action implicitly issues credit, pays cash, enables checkout or approves tax treatment

cases.scenario: Owner and manager plan/commit; buyer/cashier and forged role attempt the same action
cases.expected: Only current enabled owner/manager authorized; persisted current role rechecked; zero provider calls for denials

cases.scenario: Foreign tenant submits guessed claim, plan, trade, request or location IDs
cases.expected: No cross-tenant row/result/provider call or existence leak; tenant body field rejected

cases.scenario: Missing CSRF cookie request, cross-origin relay or unknown URL/header/raw provider payload fields
cases.expected: Denied before domain/provider processing; Bearer and local nonce boundaries preserved

cases.scenario: Staff disabled, session revoked or MFA version changed between catalog and inventory admission
cases.expected: No next provider step admitted; current unknown step preserved; authorized manager can recover same operation

cases.scenario: Enrolled current MFA just within/at/beyond 15 minutes, unenrolled account, stale MFA version; new cash/credit acceptance, additional delivery and Square writes
cases.expected: Only policy-valid current owner/manager proofs admit new sensitive action; actionable enroll/sign-in UX; ordinary claim read/create remains separately authorized

cases.scenario: Requested receiving scopes exist but actual introspection omits ITEMS_WRITE or INVENTORY_WRITE
cases.expected: Receiving unavailable; re-consent message; zero catalog/inventory writes

cases.scenario: Token status wrong app/merchant, expired/malformed result or unavailable Sandbox proof
cases.expected: Fail closed; never substitute configured requested scopes for actual proof

cases.scenario: Refresh/re-consent during pending step; then attempt another merchant/environment
cases.expected: Same verified principal may recover original exact request by approved policy; identity change blocked, key/body unchanged

cases.scenario: Missing, inactive, wrong-merchant, wrong-currency or unavailable location; multiple active choices
cases.expected: Explicit valid location required; never default first; zero mutation on unsupported location

cases.scenario: Two independent clients import identical CSV under different local IDs/request keys/locations and plan simultaneously
cases.expected: One tenant physical claim and at most one receiving operation; second client resumes/conflicts without another inventory call

cases.scenario: Same source re-export changes row order, filename, line endings, price, storage, review flags or local row UUIDs
cases.expected: Raw or server semantic evidence resolves existing occurrence; no new claim from mutable cosmetic fields

cases.scenario: Original source rows corrected during review; same raw file reimported elsewhere
cases.expected: Original source manifest/source-line IDs remain; correction evidence stays on same claim; no new physical occurrence

cases.scenario: Same-content actual new delivery requested twice with one override key, then disguised by random key
cases.expected: Explicit linked manager/owner reason+attestation required; stable retry returns one new occurrence; no silent bypass

cases.scenario: Manual intake starts without a central tag; second PC uses copied reference versus fresh per-PC UUID
cases.expected: No receiving from local UUID as physical proof; shared reference resumes same claim; explicit new-stack procedure and audit required

cases.scenario: Different raw/semantic aliases resolve to conflicting existing claims or several legitimate deliveries
cases.expected: Deterministic matching or explicit conflict/selection; no silent merge, release or guessed occurrence

cases.scenario: Selected rows exclude part of the original source or exceed 100 targets
cases.expected: Counts distinguish selected/excluded; excluded not received; no silent split/new-delivery workaround; enforce chosen continuation policy before write

cases.scenario: Receipt or plan is soft-deleted/restored after confirmation or uncertainty
cases.expected: Central physical claim/journal remain; deletion/restoration cannot create another stock receipt

cases.scenario: Same physical CSV imported on two PCs creates different local trade references and concurrent acceptance attempts
cases.expected: Central claim linked before acceptance permits at most one credit and one inventory receipt; unsupported legacy trade path gated

cases.scenario: Accepted trade line/customer/quantity/intake amount replaced by caller-supplied data
cases.expected: Server derives immutable accepted facts; wrong tenant/trade/customer or mismatched line rejected; retail price remains separate

cases.scenario: Managed existing tracked variation has matching card identity/effective location price
cases.expected: Add quantity only; no catalog reprice or field/version/sibling changes

cases.scenario: New price for existing card with old stock, sibling and location overrides
cases.expected: First slice review-only with zero writes; expanded implementation must create/reuse correct new-price sibling while preserving every old variant/count/field

cases.scenario: Duplicate SKU, generated 12-digit collision, unmanaged legacy match, missing anchor or conflicting identity metadata
cases.expected: No inventory; explicit review rather than adopting by SKU alone; no old variation deletion

cases.scenario: Seller changes catalog version/price/availability after preflight or parallel receiving hits seller catalog contention
cases.expected: Stale/conflicting plan stops; preserve full fields and exact retry key; serialized lane/backoff does not produce duplicate sibling

cases.scenario: New parent requested without approved owner-reviewed server tax/catalog template; future template-enabled batch has missing/duplicate/foreign mappings
cases.expected: Default-off zero writes; future approved path uses only verified server-returned targets, never temporary '#' or wrong-object inventory submission

cases.scenario: Boolean/fractional/negative/overflow quantity or cents, unreviewed/unpriced row, unconfirmed zero, duplicate slab certificate, oversized body
cases.expected: Explicit bounded rejection of whole request before writes; no truncation or zero-price inference

cases.scenario: Crash immediately before provider dispatch and immediately after provider commit but before local result save
cases.expected: Durable request exists first; restart retries same exact payload/key/API version/time; at most one inventory adjustment per source line

cases.scenario: Two servers or PCs commit/recover one plan concurrently; one lease expires midcall
cases.expected: Unique durable operation/step ownership and provider idempotency prevent duplicate effect; unknown seller lane remains occupied

cases.scenario: Catalog succeeds but inventory fails or response is lost; request returns HTTP200 with errors or malformed JSON
cases.expected: Partial/unknown state retained honestly; no complete flag, key rotation, silent rollback, catalog deletion or duplicate intake

cases.scenario: Missing history evidence, only aggregate inventory count, paginated changes, wrong reference/qty/location/application
cases.expected: Aggregate count alone never proves this operation; all relevant pages validated or remain needs_review

cases.scenario: Cancel before first write versus while catalog/inventory is admitted or unknown
cases.expected: Prewrite cancel is safe and durable; later cancel does not free claim or hide possibly applied mutation

cases.scenario: Retry after long delay would require changing occurred_at or provider idempotency assumptions
cases.expected: No invented permanent replay guarantee; retain original request; if proof unavailable require manager reconciliation, never new key blindly

cases.scenario: Existing legacy catalog:/stock: SQLite request pending/confirmed, received status, or changed local Square token/environment
cases.expected: No hosted plan fallback/replay; preserve original journal and provider binding; explain recovery path without exposing token

cases.scenario: Old unreceived receipt lacks immutable original manifest; operator tries to synthesize it from current edited cards
cases.expected: Require verified original reimport or explicit migration review; never pretend edited body is original evidence

cases.scenario: Commit target changes, old window submits, logout/store switch occurs during deferred response
cases.expected: Immutable receipt/claim/plan target plus current local nonce/generation; no late update or foreign-store retry; pending details hidden signed out

cases.scenario: Cloud offline, corrupted encrypted journal, app restart, lost final success and recovered different SKU labels
cases.expected: No local-token fallback; retain fail-closed journal; recover same operation; replace stale labels only after confirmed SKU mapping

cases.scenario: Inspect responses, status APIs, errors and audit/log output for unauthenticated/cashier/foreign-store requests
cases.expected: No Square token, auth header, password, customer contact, raw provider body or unrelated receipt; minimal authorized audit retained

cases.scenario: Independent seller re-consents in Sandbox/production, exact store device/location, revoked/missing permissions and external catalog edits
cases.expected: Controlled authorized provider acceptance and redacted evidence; no claim based solely on fixtures or current documentation

cases.scenario: Same central intake and copied CSV/manually tagged stack received from two actual PCs, including outage/reconnect
cases.expected: One authoritative stock outcome and consistent status on both; no duplicate credit; receipts/labels reference confirmed SKU; hardware/format supported matrix recorded
